relations.myth: The daily works of the Anjanas
relations.note: Anjanas repair natural damage caused by Ojáncanos and embody their moral opposite.
Later systematizations contrast the beneficent Anjana with the destructive female ogress.
Anjanas drink its gall, which cures disease and reveals buried treasure.
Later retellings describe Anjanas as beings sent by God to do good.

relations.myth: The Anjana beneath the river pool
relations.note: The Anjana gives a woodcutter instructions for releasing the maiden from a tree.
